'''''Champion of Iridonia''''' was a [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] that was the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|fleet]] sent to [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]] early on in the [[Jedi Civil War]]. [[Acaadi]] attempted to sabotage it during the [[Battle of Iridonia (Jedi Civil War)|Battle of Iridonia]].
